title.en: How do JDV and GDS differ?

subtitle.zh: 一张图看懂从版图交付到光罩Release
subtitle.en: From layout delivery to mask release in one diagram

body.zh: METAL；VIA；POLY；DIFF；WELL；.gds；GDS版图（设计数据）；数据处理与检查；.mdp；Reticle 光罩（成像数据）；投影到晶圆
body.en: METAL VIA POLY DIFF WELL .gds GDS layout (design data) Data processing and checks .mdp Reticle (imaging data) Projection onto the wafer

body.zh: 01；一句话定位|GDS是设计意图，JDV是写版确认；GDS表达设计师要做什么；JDV用于确认要写出的光罩是什么。
body.en: 01 In one sentence | GDS represents design intent; JDV confirms mask writing GDS describes what the designer wants; JDV confirms the mask to be written

body.zh: GDS（设计意图）；我要实现的电路；JDV（写版确认）；实际要写的光罩
body.en: GDS (design intent) The circuit to implement JDV (mask-writing verification) The actual mask to write

body.zh: 02；数据阶段|GDS在前，JDV接近Mask Release；GDS在Tape-out阶段输出；JDV通常出现在Mask Release前。
body.en: 02 Data stage | GDS comes first; JDV is close to mask release GDS is output at tape-out; JDV usually appears before mask release

body.zh: 设计；Design；验证；Sign-off；Tape-out；（GDS输出）；MDP制版；（数据处理）；Mask Release；（JDV）；.gds；.mdp
body.en: Design Design Verification Sign-off Tape-out (GDS output) MDP (data processing) Mask release (JDV) .gds .mdp

body.zh: 03；GDS装什么 |保存Cell、图形、层次与Layer；GDS以层次化方式保存几何图形及其所在Layer信息。
body.en: 03 What GDS contains | cells, shapes, hierarchy and layers GDS hierarchically stores geometric shapes and their layer information

body.zh: Cell层次树；Top Cell；Top Cell；Block A；Block B；Cell A1；Cell A2；Cell B1；Cell B2
body.en: Cell hierarchy Top cell Top cell Block A Block B Cell A1 Cell A2 Cell B1 Cell B2

body.zh: Layer示例；M1；VIA1；M2；POLY；DIFF
body.en: Layer examples M1 VIA1 M2 POLY DIFF

body.zh: 04；JDV看什么 | 检查Mask、Reticle与Job信息；JDV关注成像数据本身及其在Reticle/Job中的完整性与一致性。
body.en: 04 What JDV checks | mask, reticle and job information JDV examines imaging data and its completeness and consistency within the reticle/job

body.zh: Reticle信息；尺寸、边框、对准标记、坐标原点
body.en: Reticle information Dimensions, frame, alignment marks and coordinate origin

body.zh: Mask图形；写入图形、层号、极性（Tone）
body.en: Mask shapes Written shapes, layer numbers and tone

body.zh: Job信息；工艺、机台、分辨率、焦深、批次
body.en: Job information Process, tool, resolution, depth of focus and lot

body.zh: 对比与一致性；MDP vs JDV、版本、校验和
body.en: Comparison and consistency MDP versus JDV, version and checksum

body.zh: 05；中间转换| GDS经过MDP才走到JDV；MDP将GDS转为面向写版的数据，并加入工艺与规则处理。
body.en: 05 Intermediate conversion | GDS passes through MDP before JDV MDP converts GDS into mask-writing data, adding process and rule handling

body.zh: MDP处理；规则检查；OPC/修饰；分块/分割；数据格式化
body.en: MDP processing Rule checks OPC / correction Partitioning / fracturing Data formatting

body.zh: .gds；设计数据；（GDS）；.mdp；写版数据；（MDP）；JDV查看；写版确认；（JDV）
body.en: .gds Design data (GDS) .mdp Mask-writing data (MDP) JDV viewing Mask-writing verification (JDV)

body.zh: 06；Review清单|版本、方向、Tone、Frame逐项确认；签核前按清单逐项确认，避免低级错误导致返工。
body.en: 06 Review checklist | verify version, orientation, tone and frame Confirm each checklist item before sign-off to prevent avoidable rework

body.zh: 版本一致；GDS/MDP/JDV 版本号匹配
body.en: Version consistency Matching GDS/MDP/JDV version numbers

body.zh: 方向与原点；旋转、镜像、原点位置正确
body.en: Orientation and origin Correct rotation, mirroring and origin

body.zh: Tone极性；正片/负片与工艺要求一致
body.en: Tone Positive/negative tone consistent with process requirements

body.zh: Frame与边界；写入边框、留白、禁写区
body.en: Frame and boundaries Write frame, blank margins and no-write areas

body.zh: 标记与对准；对准标记、测量标记完整
body.en: Marks and alignment Complete alignment and measurement marks

body.zh: 其它检查；Layer映射、校验和、注释
body.en: Other checks Layer mapping, checksum and annotations

body.zh: 07；正常差异 | OPC与Fracture会改变图形外观；为提升成像质量，OPC修饰与Fracture碎片化会改变外观但属正常。
body.en: 07 Normal differences | OPC and fracturing change shape appearance OPC correction and fracturing normally change appearance to improve imaging

body.zh: Pre-OPC；（设计图形）；OPC修饰；Post-OPC；（写版图形）
body.en: Pre-OPC (design shapes) OPC correction Post-OPC (mask-writing shapes)

body.zh: Fracture前（大图形）；Fracture分割；Fracture后；（分块图形）
body.en: Before fracturing (large shape) Fracturing After fracturing (partitioned shapes)

body.zh: 08；Release边界 | JDV签核不是万能验证；JDV仅验证写版数据是否正确，不能替代电性或良率验证。
body.en: 08 Release limits | JDV sign-off is not universal validation JDV verifies mask-writing data; it cannot replace electrical or yield validation

body.zh: JDV能保证（写版层面）；数据完整性与一致性；图形/层/极性正确；Reticle与Job信息正确；JDV SIGN-OFF
body.en: What JDV verifies (mask-writing level) Data completeness and consistency Correct shapes, layers and tone Correct reticle and job information JDV SIGN-OFF

body.zh: JDV不能保证（产品层面）；电路功能与时序正确；工艺良率与可靠性；封装/测试/系统问题
body.en: What JDV cannot guarantee (product level) Correct circuit function and timing Process yield and reliability Packaging / test / system issues
